deadline.value: December 15 for fall, including TOEFL/IELTS scores. Year inferred for Fall 2027.
deadline.quote: The deadline for all application materials for fall admission is December 15th. This includes all supporting materials such as the scores of TOEFL and IELTS.

app_fee.value: USD 75 international (USD 60 domestic); covers up to two program selections
app_fee.quote: The graduate application fee is $60 (U.S. dollars) for domestic applicants and $75 (U.S. dollars) for international applicants.

fee_waiver.value: Fee-waiver applications exist through Big Ten and Purdue; check eligibility for international applicants
fee_waiver.quote: An application fee waiver may apply. Both Big Ten and Purdue offer applications for fee waivers.

gre_general.quote: PHYS GRE and General GRE are not required but are optional.

gre_physics.quote: PHYS GRE and General GRE are not required but are optional.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL, IELTS and Duolingo accepted; minimum not shown on the pages checked
toefl_min.quote: The TOEFL (Test of English as a Foreign Language), IELTS (International English Language Testing System), and Duolingo English test evaluate a person’s level of English proficiency

english_waiver.value: Exemption rules not shown on the pages checked

funding.value: Most common support is a half-time (20 h/week) teaching assistantship; tick the box on the main application
funding.quote: The most common form of financial assistance offered by the Department is the half-time (20 hours per week) graduate teaching assistantship.

notes: Purdue states that from August 15, 2026, Indiana law requires additional review steps for some international applicants. Oral English certification is required to keep a TA appointment for non-native speakers.
